class.name: NetwAuthProtocol
class.brief_description: Reads and writes the packets Networked sends during [SceneMultiplayer] authentication.
class.description: A packet starts with four bytes that say what it is. A joining player sends [code]"NHEL"[/code], then a version byte, an 8-byte build tag, a flags byte, and the game's own authentication data. A server browser sends [code]"NPRB"[/code], then a version byte and a flags or status byte, and the reply follows. A server browser gets its reply and is disconnected, so it never appears in the [MultiplayerAPI].

method.name: classify
method.description: Returns what kind of packet [param data] is.

method.name: decode_client_hello
method.description: Reads a join packet. It is rejected when its build tag differs from [param local_app_tag]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴ok bool false when rejected ┠╴reason String "framing", "version" or "app", empty when ok ┠╴version int the version in the packet ┠╴app_tag int the build tag in the packet ┖╴flags int reserved [/codeblock]

method.name: decode_probe_reply
method.description: Reads a server browser reply. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴ok bool false when the packet is invalid ┠╴version int the version in the packet ┠╴status int a ProbeStatus value ┖╴payload PackedByteArray the reply, empty when invalid [/codeblock]

method.name: decode_probe_request
method.description: Reads a server browser request. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴ok bool false when the packet is invalid ┠╴version int the version in the packet ┖╴flags int reserved [/codeblock]

method.name: encode_client_hello
method.description: Writes a join packet header with the build tag [param app_tag]. See [method NetwMultiplayer.auth_set_app_tag].

method.name: encode_probe_reply
method.description: Writes a server browser reply with [param status] and [param payload].

method.name: encode_probe_request
method.description: Writes a server browser request. [param flags] is reserved.

method.name: magic_hello
method.description: The first four bytes of a join packet, [code]"NHEL"[/code].

method.name: magic_probe
method.description: The first four bytes of a server browser packet, [code]"NPRB"[/code].

method.name: protocol_version
method.description: The packet version this build writes. It accepts no other.

constants.constant: A server browser asking about the server.
The reply carries the server info.
The server does not answer server browsers.
